note: ranges and defaults of convert.py / stream.py; hard limits (the format or the board cannot do it) stop with an error, recommended ranges only warn; the board's numbers (clock, flash, drawing cycles) are in its board.json (--board)

screen.note: the biggest screen of this project (M130T); pictures are clipped, so bigger is only wasted data

flash.note: pixels in flash (output/*.h), drawn by image::FlashImage

stream.note: pixels stay on the computer (in output/*.h, after #if 0), stream.py sends them to image::StreamImage; the board only has the size and the path (output/*.h); palette 256 works (the board keeps it in RAM taken at run time, 2 bytes a color), but warns
